citations.claim: body speed at violating step 406 where controller_force 101.72 exceeds fmax 42.95
previous step speed shows normal flight with force clamped

counterfactual.change: Increased fmax from 42.95 to 200 - raw required force ~101.7 is now within limit so violation disappears

explanation: Controller enforces fmax=42.95 correctly for most flight (steps 404-405 force clamped at limit per shrink detail) but at step 406 force spikes to 101.72 exceeding limit. Increasing fmax to 200 eliminates violation, showing the force-computation/clamping path is not uniformly applied - likely waypoint-approach velocity-error law fails to clamp.
vision_note: The red/orange controller-driven body hovers immediately to the right of the green waypoint cross across steps 403 to 406 with almost imperceptible motion. No wall contact, tunneling, or sudden position jump is visible; the trajectory looks nominally stationary at the waypoint approach.
